title: Unknown Fossils and Eggs
text: Suspicious sand in the ancient Earth layer contains unknown organism fossils and eggs. The reverser recalls a fossil as a tyrannosaur, mosasaur or pterosaur remnant with equal chances; condensation yields its essence. Unknown eggs become dormant organism eggs or spirit seeds; advanced condensation restores their vitality.

Use an active spirit seed to summon a translucent Archaeopteryx Spirit, or an active organism egg to summon a Velociraptor. This is their only source. They are immediately tamed to you and follow you. The spirit has 16 health and deals 6 base damage with a flying charge; the raptor has 20 health and deals 6 base damage with a melee bite. Both recover half their maximum health every minute.

Sneak-use your companion to switch between following and staying. Use your raptor to ride without a saddle, steer and jump; sneak to dismount. Both are time creatures, immune to Decayed Timeflow's wither and slowdown, Reversion Mire's rewind and Eventide Ruins' life-ending cycle.
Archaeopteryx Spirits drop 2–4 Time Warp Points. Velociraptors drop 1–2 Time Warp Points, 2–4 bones and 2–4 rotten flesh.
